purpose: Bracket each ingredient decision-time DM fraction d_i implied by the released one-decimal fixed rations through the structural planned-DM equality sum_i q_i d_i = D_case. Only interval widths are stored; no bounds or point values.

formulation.unknowns: d_i for the 9 ingredients on the B/C axis; planned DM supply D_case, one per case
formulation.bounds: d_i in [0.05, 1]; D_case in [20, 35] kg DM/d
formulation.public_equalities: D_A = D_C, D_R0 = D_B, D_A = 1.10 * D_R0 (single scale variable D_R0; the [20, 35] box applies to every case present, so D_R0 in [20, 35/1.1] when A or C is included)
formulation.constraints: for every released distinct vector v of case c: |sum_i qtilde_vi d_i - D_c| <= 0.05 * sum_{i in inventory of c} d_i (worst-case one-decimal rounding; for R0/A the cottonseed term is absent)
formulation.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog, method highs; minimise and maximise each d_i; all LPs feasible (status 0)
formulation.width: (max d_i - min d_i) x 100, in DM percentage points; 95.0 = the full prior box, i.e. not constrained beyond the prior bounds

all_released_D_unknown.description: Primary check as specified: all 16 distinct one-decimal vectors of fixed_rations_released.csv (R0 3, A 4, B 3, C 6); planned DM unknown.

AC_Q0Q2_D_unknown.description: Smaller release set: only the A and C fixed rations of Q0 and Q2 (6 + 6 released rows; 8 distinct vectors); one unknown planned DM (D_A = D_C).

all_released_D_from_retained_requirement.description: Sensitivity: as the primary check, but D restricted to the interval implied by the retained requirement rows (see planned_DM_reconstructable_from_retained_rows).

AC_Q0Q2_D_from_retained_requirement_rows.description: Sensitivity: smaller release set with D restricted as above.

planned_DM_reconstructable_from_retained.finding: The retained rows still determine planned DM: |absorbed requirement - actual-D row bound| / row DM coefficient equals D_case for both Ca and P (row-bound sign convention handled by the absolute value). With +/-0.05 g/d rounding on the two released g/d rows and the released coefficient taken as exact, the implied interval is narrow and contains the restricted source value in every case.
planned_DM_reconstructable_from_retained.implication: Removing planned_dm_supply_kg_d and dmi_eq2_1_kg_d_build_report does not withhold planned DM; withholding it would also require dropping, for both Ca and P, the absorbed requirement, the actual-D row bound or the row DM coefficient. The NEL linear intercept C0 also depends on planned DM; whether it is invertible was not checked.

scope_limits: Only the planned-DM-equality route is assessed. Other routes, e.g. relative cost premiums combined with public prices (README_S21_DECISION.md section 4, route 5), and any additional released rations (e.g. S21 draft tables) are not included; adding them requires rerunning this check.
